items.answer_raw: 2 or 3 plur. fem. impf. Qal of שָׁפֵל
1 sing. pf. Qal of קָטֹן
2 sing. masc. or 3 sing. fem. impf. Qal of קָטֹן
3 sing. fem. pf. Qal of יָכֹל
2 plur. masc. pf. Qal of יָכֹל (see § 22. 1 b)
1 sing. impf. Qal of שָׁכֹל
2 sing. fem. imperat. Qal of לָבֵשׁ (לָבַשׁ is also found)
1 plur. impf. Qal of כָּבֵד
2 sing. fem. impf. Qal of כָּבֵד
1 sing. impf. Qal of גָּדֵל
3 plur. pf. Qal of רָעֵב (pausal form of רָעֲבוּ)
Thou art not able to count the stars.
The name of Yahweh will be great for ever.

items.body_raw: קְרַב וּשְׁמַע אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי דֹבֵר אֵלֶיךָ
items.answer_raw: Draw near (sing.) and hearken to all the words which I am about to speak unto thee.

items.body_raw: עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים אָתָּה
items.answer_raw: Now I know that thou fearest God.
O Yahweh, my God, thou art very great.

items.body_raw: זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה וְשֵׁם רְשָׁעִים יִרְקָב
items.answer_raw: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked shall rot.

items.body_raw: קָרוֹב אַתָּה יהוה וְכָל־מִצְוֹתֶיךָ אֱמֶת תִּקְרַב רִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ
items.answer_raw: Nigh art thou, O Yahweh, and all thy commandments are truth, my ringing cry shall come near before thee.
No flesh can be righteous before thee.

items.body_raw: קדוש אתה יהוה מלאה כל־הארץ כבודך
items.answer_raw: Holy art thou, O Yahweh, all the earth is full of thy glory.

items.body_raw: שבעתי עולות ודם פרים לא חפצתי
items.answer_raw: I am sated with burnt-offerings, and in the blood of oxen I delight not.
לֹא יָכֹלְתִּי לִקְרֹב
אֶגְדַּל
קְרַב (sing.) or קִרְבוּ (plur.)

items.body_raw: The God who made the heavens and the earth I (am) fearing.
items.answer_raw: אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲנִי יָרֵא

items.body_raw: Ye cannot keep my statutes with (בְּ) all your heart.
items.answer_raw: לֹא יְכָלְתֶּם לִשְׁמֹר אֶת־פִּקּוּדַי בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶם
קָטֹנְתְּ (fem.) or קָטֹנְתָּ (masc.)

items.body_raw: Hear in order that thou mayest learn to fear Yahweh thy God.
items.answer_raw: שְׁמַע לְמַעַן תִּלְמַד לְיִרְאָה אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ

items.body_raw: They are not able to pursue after me.
items.answer_raw: לֹא יָכְלוּ לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרָי
שָׁכָלְתִּי

items.body_raw: I know that thou shalt assuredly reign.
items.answer_raw: יָדַעְתִּי כִּי מָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ

items.body_raw: Cease to draw near before me, for your hands are full of blood (pl.).
items.answer_raw: חִדְלוּ לִקְרֹב לְפָנַי כִּי מָלְאוּ יְדֵיכֶם דָּמִים

items.body_raw: How great art thou (O) my God, very deep are thy thoughts.
items.answer_raw: מַה־גָּדַלְתָּ אֱלֹהַי עָמְקוּ מְאֹד מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ

items.body_raw: אַל־תִּקְרַב הֲלֹם כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עוֹמֵד עָלָיו אַדְמַת קֹדֶשׁ הוּא
items.answer_raw: Draw not nigh hither, for the place whereon thou art standing is holy ground.
Let us draw nigh to Yahweh, that he may judge between me and thee.
אַל־תִּקְרְבוּ

items.body_raw: Sarah bare to her husband a son, and the boy grew up.
items.answer_raw: יָלְדָה שָׂרָה לְאִישָׁהּ בֵּן וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד
Thy silver and gold I do not delight in.

items.body_raw: All his prophets are dumb dogs, they cannot bark.
items.answer_raw: כָּל־נְבִיאָיו כְּלָבִים אִלְּמִים לֹא יָכְלוּ לִנְבֹּחַ
